_meta.description: Static map from each Universe stock (Yahoo ticker) - the FTSE 350 and the S&P 500 - to one Primary Sector and optional Secondary Sectors from config.SECTORS. primary_sector null = Unmapped Stock. US stocks are never mapped into the UK-specific Sectors (see lse_stock_analysis/sp500_map.py). Refresh after each quarterly index review with: python -m lse_stock_analysis.universe_check
